data.exact_reserve_text: A surplus run-off amount of GBP 18.1m was experienced in 2017 (2016: GBP 8.6m deficit). This was made up of a surplus on the prior year claims provisions of GBP 22.5m on direct business (2016: GBP 14.1m deficit) and a GBP 4.4m deficit on reinsurance accepted business (2016: GBP 5.5m surplus).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 18.1 million in 2017, representing a 6.6% release against opening gross claims outstanding. This favorable development was primarily driven by a GBP 22.5 million surplus on direct business, partially offset by a GBP 4.4 million deficit on reinsurance accepted business. No specific causal events or affected prior years were detailed for this movement, which is described as a general "surplus run-off amount".
